name: Apex Legacy 300K · holder's EOD reading, not Apex's rule
source: Account holder 2026-09-28: "legacy 300k", "35 mini contract limit", "max DD of 7500", "the profit goal is 20000, 0 daily drawdown, and EOD trail locks at +100". Minimum days and consistency were not named: taken as the Legacy 50K's (none; a single day can pass). Floor: $7,500 below the EOD peak, locking at $300,100 (+$100) once the EOD peak reaches +$7,600. THIS FILE IS THE ACCOUNT HOLDER'S END-OF-DAY READING, NOT WHAT APEX'S HELP CENTRE SAYS. Apex (https://apextraderfunding.com/help-center/evaluation-accounts-ea/legacy-evaluation-rules/, read 2026-10-11; research/prop-portfolio/2026-10-01-l2/APEX300_RULES.md): a Legacy account's threshold trails the highest LIVE balance during trades (intraday, open profit included), not the end-of-day balance; the 300K's drawdown is $7,500 as here; the evaluation needs 7 trading days unless a one-day-pass promotion is on; on Tradovate the evaluation's threshold never stops trailing. This simulator cannot trail an intraday high, so these odds are the FRIENDLY reading: Apex's own rule passes less often and busts more often. The payout block is LucidFlex's, not Apex's (Apex: 8 trading days, 5 of them >= $50, largest day <= 30% of the profit, a safety net, at most $3,500 a payout; the PA trades half size until the safety net). Apex bans automated trading on Performance Accounts.
